overall_assessment:
1. Assessment and scope
No new material blocking finding is established in the affected r41 package. The current implementation substantively resolves SEC-R35-01 and ADH-R35-01: omitted-resource retention now uses current reducer-owned selection, and the supplied current validation covers both abandoning A through Novo and switching from A to B before an older account-page response completes. This is a candidate security reassessment, not delivery or activation approval. No tools, file edits, independent hash recomputation or live attack execution were performed.

2. Security framing and attack surfaces
Security risk remains high; controlled attack simulation remains required. Reviewed surfaces include BFF session/CSRF enforcement, current tenant/BU grants, draft ownership versus administrator authority, account and credential binding, observation authority, operation recovery, persistence queries, escaped rendering, cursors, secrets and provider-read amplification. The supplied local adversarial evidence is relevant to these boundaries. Threat-intelligence input is limited to the embedded references and prior dispositions; this review provides no fresh dependency-advisory or external-provider compatibility clearance. No new agent-ingestion or tool-execution surface is introduced by the delta.

3. Current selection ownership and observation authority
The catalogue action no longer declares or reads a request-start selected resource. selectedRemoteTemplateId is nullable metadata within the existing reducer, alongside the two observation slices. Reviewing the twelve draft-state commit sites shows corresponding selection establishment or clearing: guarded open/save/create/resume/submit/recovery/operation commits establish the associated remote identity, while Novo, variation and context changes clear it. Selection can be established without a saved observation, which is necessary for page-only retention. The named pure fixtures' extra stale-A action field is deliberately adversarial structural input; it is not a shipped compatibility field.

On page adoption, the reducer compares returned items against existing same-resource page observations, then applies the response's exact membership and cursor. If the current selected resource is omitted, it retains that resource's highest known observation in the existing individual slice. It neither reinserts omitted IDs into page membership nor retains abandoned A after selection has cleared. The B/301 PAUSED versus B/300 APPROVED transition and the page-only B branch now have passing pure assertions; the supplied browser cases exercise actual BFF responses and confirm B remains PAUSED/ineligible after the held empty page arrives.

The surrounding authority distinctions remain intact. A 202 does not complete meaningful observation authority; derived reads inherit the originating intent; passive reads do not promote intent authority; context resets reject prior-context work. Persisted observation fences remain separate from request order. Common catalogue eligibility is preserved independently of draft-definition and ACK-association restrictions at equal fences, while editor eligibility still requires positive matchesDefinition and eligibleForUse proof. Historical TEMPLATE_CONTEXT_STALE classification survives failure, allowing lower-fence current-context evidence to supersede historical higher-fence evidence. The correction introduces no status-derived approval, relaxed editor proof, additional HTTP or third observation cache.

4. Authentication, authorization and safe diagnostics
The controller captures session claims and supplies revalidation to observation commits. The shown success and unavailable transactions revalidate the session and current actor/BU/draft authority, with lease and mutable-context checks before persistence. ADMIN authority over another author's draft is checked again after provider I/O. Authorized historical reads remain distinct from current mutation authority; current-context resolution requires the same tenant, BU, channel, managed identity and account association before adopting renewed-generation observations.

The changed API test preserves the actual cookie/session/CSRF/BFF/Prisma/PostgreSQL path. Its tagged race requires provider entry before invalidation; an early HTTP result, rejection or diagnostic deadline fails the case instead of masquerading as successful boundary reachability. The expiry override remains active until genuine HTTP settlement. Cleanup releases the held gate, awaits outstanding requests and restores the observation clock and fetch replacement. Fixed diagnostic labels and numeric statuses disclose no cookies, tokens, identifiers, response bodies or raw errors.

The r41 receipt reports seven actual provider entries, followed by six 401 responses and one ADMIN-downgrade 403, with unchanged observation/page snapshots and completed cleanup. The 92 diagnostic records are breadcrumbs across those cases, not 92 independent security scenarios. These results support the present revalidation behavior. They do not locate or explain the historical r39 timeout, which remains unattributed and must not be described as fixed or proven flaky.

5. Other trust boundaries and decision adherence
No new tenant breakout, arbitrary WABA/token selection, recipient-send path or privilege escalation is established. Account identity is derived server-side; the global technical reservation/quota namespace does not itself grant access to scoped drafts or operations. The shown queries use bound parameters. Preview text remains escaped JSX, with authoritative validation in the backend. Cursor size and explicit-page semantics remain bounded; unchanged adapter behavior is carried from prior assurance rather than independently reverified here.

D01–D03 remain preserved: seller submission, scoped ownership, authoritative preview, revisioned drafts and explicit variations. D04 remains preserved through historical/current-context separation and server-owned credential/account resolution. D05–D06 and CR-01/02 retain their approved authorization, durable-operation, one-POST, explicit-recovery and conservative-outcome semantics on the carried producer evidence. Associated remote identity, immutable acknowledged acceptance and local receipt certainty remain separate facts; no current delta warrants reopening the accepted ACK design. D07–D08's affected selection exceptions are addressed by the current reducer and supplied regressions, subject to the explicitly accepted failure-availability debt. D09 retains the narrow template capability, scoped resolver and ChannelTransportModule reuse. AR-V11-01/02 remain unchanged; AR-V11-03 is supported by supplied source/seal attestations, not hashes recomputed by this reviewer. CR-V11-01 retains the shared backend lease/fence/projector and the consumer's separate admission checks. Omitted unchanged ACK/provider methods are carried assurance, not a fresh complete source audit.

6. Performance, elegance and structural soundness
Performance is acceptable for this delta. Selection metadata adds constant-sized state; reconciliation operates over explicitly loaded observations using temporary indexes and bounded passes, without provider fan-out, page-walking exact lookup or additional requests. Supplied PostgreSQL evidence retains parent pagination before child hydration, detail limits of eleven operations and ten receipts per operation, and catalogue hydration with at most fifty indexed observation probes in one statement. OFFSET, exact-count and sequential bounded-write costs remain disclosed; the synthetic measurements establish no production capacity or SLO.

Elegance is acceptable. Extending the existing pure reducer with current selection metadata directly addresses the demonstrated cross-slice dependency and avoids another cache, mirrored ref or generic framework. The manual selection wiring is consistent across the supplied commit sites; no cosmetic refactor is necessary for closure. Structural soundness and operational fit remain mixed because accepted code-only failure provenance can conservatively withdraw availability from newer passive evidence, and later operational gates remain outstanding. That limitation preserves canonical status/time/fence/content and does not demonstrate stale APPROVED promotion.

7. Evidence limits, accepted debt and readiness
The supplied current canonical command, bash scripts/test-channels-local.sh all, completed with 802 passing cases: 284 API unit, 398 PostgreSQL, 45 Web unit and 75 Playwright, comprising 74 browser cases and one pure consumer case. The receipt reports 38 matching sources, thirty protected seals, three unchanged HEADs, current source/runtime attribution, matching served/dist bytes and all five template markers. Both template FRC markers originate in the browser main workflow: separately, 100 real BFF refresh requests with 99 safe 202 responses and one completed leader, and 100 UI attempts coalesced into one BFF refresh. These are supplied attestations, not independently reproduced results.

r36 establishes only its reached pure causal failures; its later page-only branch and the new browser sequences were not pre-fix browser REDs. r37 was a compilation failure, and r38's final counter repair selects the fixture's normal request record while preserving the expected two creates and preceding business assertions. Current GREEN does not expand historical fail-first claims. TQA-ST05-03 remains accepted original test-after/unknown process debt. The new valid empty catalogue-page cases do not erase the previously disclosed empty-200 browser boundary limit; browser ACK-conflict-race coverage also remains unestablished.

OPS-R4-01 remains accepted nonblocking debt under foundation_documentation/backlog/README.md#BLG-leadshug-template-failure-observation-authority, owned by Web/integrations, with explicit successful refresh as recovery. Mandatory backend CAS and consumer fences are not waived. SEC-R6-04 remains deferred through foundation_documentation/backlog/README.md#BLG-leadshug-template-recovery-read-budget, owned by integrations-and-channels/security and restricted to the existing private local cohort; sequential authorized recovery can still amplify provider reads. Operator-reported credential revocation/disablement is accepted containment without reconfirmation or retest, and establishes neither historical nonuse nor removal of previously rendered text.

Fresh current lane dispositions and formal PCV disposition remain required. Preserved local TEST metadata preflight, the two additive migrations, source-bound API/Web activation, owned HTTPS and normal access, one assisted actual Meta draft/submit-once/status proof, canonical module consolidation and fresh final review remain mandatory. Fixtures prove neither actual Meta compatibility/approval nor preserved activation, external exactly-once behavior, hosted CI or production readiness. Delivery remains Pending.
recommended_path: Accept this affected candidate security reassessment with no new blocking findings, and resolve SEC-R35-01/ADH-R35-01 against the current implementation and supplied r41 evidence. Carry the recorded availability, private-cohort read-budget and test-provenance debt without reopening unchanged accepted semantics. Complete the other current assurance lanes and formal PCV disposition before the approved preserved TEST preflight, migrations, source-bound activation and assisted Meta proof. Final review must consume that actual operational evidence before closeout; this result grants no activation, public admission, recipient send, product promotion or delivery approval.
